title: Speechless! Lucky Donald or Nicky!!
text:
Speechless! Lucky Donald or Nicky!!"

" ''I just LOVE him' — Nicki Minaj on Trump"

"From “Donald Trump Want Me Go Home” to “He’s So Handsome”: Nicki Minaj’s MAGA Glow-Up"

"She once rapped “Island girl, Donald Trump want me go home”.  "
"Now she’s holding hands with him at the Treasury, calling herself his “No. 1 fan”.  "

"She used to say his approach was “childish” — but apparently the man just needed a little more *time*.  "

"The Barbz are confused, the haters are mad, but Nicki’s just over here collecting gold cards and presidential compliments like they’re going out of style.
